utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Nell. Since it’s Sunday at the community center now, I’ll keep an eye out for the setup and let you know if I spot anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli—please do. I’m still catching up, so I’ll go by your update and head to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key and pass along that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I can help line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — Sunday at the community center should work nicely, and with a few volunteers lined up, it’ll go smoother than ever.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira — could you help sort the drop-off times and keep the parts labeled? I’m trying to keep the repair drive from getting chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit behind on what’s already been handled, so there’s probably a pile of tasks left.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. Tell me what’s left, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — it’s at the community center on Sunday now, and I can help keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that would be wonderful. If you can help line up a few volunteers, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. If you can check what still needs doing, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep it low-key and check where the repair drive is set up, then let you know what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. Sunday at the community center should make it easier to keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the Sunday repair drive at the community center and see if I can line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good plan — Sunday at the community center is easier to remember. Point me to the remaining tasks and I’ll help sort them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need to check what’s left on the repair drive list — I skimmed it, but I’m not sure what’s still needed yet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries — when you’ve checked, let me know what’s left and I’ll help keep it low-key and organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I can help a little, keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, Sunday at the community center sounds set — thanks, Uli. I’ll keep it low-key and check if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Cleo — I can bring my toolbox to the community center on Sunday if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus—that’d help a lot. I’ll check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive, and do we already have the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.
